title: System Usability Scale
description: 10 alternating statements about a system rated 1–5 on agreement.

citation.text: Brooke J (1996). SUS: a 'quick and dirty' usability scale. In: Jordan PW, Thomas B, Weerdmeester BA, McClelland IL (eds). Usability Evaluation in Industry. London: Taylor & Francis, pp. 189–194.

scoring.text: Odd items contribute (score − 1), even items (5 − score); the sum is multiplied by 2.5 for a 0–100 score. The recipe reverses the even items and computes (sum − 10) × 2.5. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.
